runtime_catalog.note: before_gate is the host scan of every skill root the host reads, counted by SKILL.md presence: .minimax/skills, .minimax/.builtin-skills and the three external roots. after_gate is the measured runtime catalog listing after the external roots were gated off and the data-directory skills were parked. listing_tokens_now is the summed on-invoke cost of the visible skills that are in the registry; listing_tokens_full_estimate is the summed on-invoke cost of every local and plugin skill, used as the pre-gate listing cost proxy; the exact pre-gate listing was not tokenised at the time.

repair.note: The taxonomy's keyword lists were repaired after an error analysis on the dev half of the benchmark. The test half was not consulted. evals/taxonomy-v1.json holds the pre-repair set and evals/taxonomy-ablation.md holds the ablation.

parking.note: The 1,343 skills under ~/.agents/skills, ~/.claude/skills and ~/.codex/skills are invisible to mcode (external roots gated off) and are the router's local library.
